about:
I am interested in the point where an idea becomes a working, testable system. My public projects document experiments with real-world data, from implementing algorithms from scratch to building reproducible workflows and examining model behavior.

Alongside AI coursework, I build backend and web projects. I am currently strengthening my machine learning and computer vision knowledge through practical work, with an emphasis on clear evaluation and useful software.
